title: When anger rises quickly as a steady practice
issueStatement: The mind reacts before truth and proportion have time to speak. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru turns the battle inward so reaction loses its claim to righteousness. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it.
actionPrompt: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Repeat what you can actually keep.
